title: Smart Pack: parcels damage verification system on Cardano.

ms.promise:
#1 - Test different types of cameras, photographic methods and box tampering sensors. Tests help determine a prototype for scanning devices. The aim of the tests is ascertain the level of detail commercial grade products have versus sensors specific to the job. 
#1 - Develop a basic phone application for photograph captures. It'll work on commercial phones. 
#2 - Capture relevant shipment metadata - carrier, date/time, etc.
#2- Transmit photos to a back-end server ex: a local database (AWS, SQL DB)
#3 - Test different AI models that will judge the photographs of the packages
ms.criteria:
#1 - Differentiate image files provided of boxes that have a variety of sizes, colors, and methods of packaging. 
#1 - A mobile app in an alpha state.
#2 - Test file capturing of the mobile application using the onboard cameras of a commercial phone.
#2 - Test with tampering sensors to judge if the information they provide is more complete than the commercial hardware. 
#3 - Test different captured images for comparison in different custom AI models that are specific for image comparison.

ms.promise:
#1 - Team members will send boxes via USPS, FedEx etc. to each other, Initially inside the USA and then to international members. We cannot give an exact number, it will depend on the needs by the performance of the model. The planned number is a minimum of 75 packages and a maximum of 200. 
#2- Data collection, apply AI models to fingerprint the packages
and look for damage.
#3 - The data will be used to test the AI models. This test involves boxes that went through the shipping process on a real life scenario. We want to judge the ability for a model to pick up on damage that happen during transit.

ms.report:
Hello,
Here are the proofs of the milestones:
1. Here are the list of the packages send for the test using the commercial package services:
・UPS
・USPS
・FedEx

The difference in format is because each of the companies report packages in a different way. Also, we have removed any information that can reveal personal data. The aim of the sheets is to show we shipped packages over commercial carriers and the cost of doing so. 
Now, here is a consolidated list which contains each package sent using the carriers and also the size of the package:
・Consolidated List

Here is the database of pictures for the experiment. 6 boxes were lost by the shipping companies (new link):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cgGIG2U0XMZPgWnzgMVokE0TXhphYsHy
2. Next, we have the analysis of the packages using our custom AI model. This was created using Tensor Flow, an open-source toolkit for image processing. We trained only with the images we had for the test:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RoHKGNXM497j5RHO9pQ1Pt8wnmNYKrrv/view?usp=sharing
The model under-performed due to the small amount of training data. We used the 100 boxes to train this data, but it was not able to recognize the damaged boxes over the regular one. It's impossible to tell how many boxes it would need to complete have enough data to have accurate information. 
We have talked with some people in the LLM world and they gave us an estimate that 100k photos is the minimum to start getting results, but that is just the floor. To train accurate models the number is probably in the millions. 
3. Another test we made was using ChatGPT. We created a automated script that fed the pictures to the model and asked it if they were damaged. Here are the results:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/188nAfuJuqJl8V0NOziXbRYf73asDqDue/view?usp=sharing
Here is a video of the ChatGPT model working (re-upload):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LTX9wy5Iiag&t=20s
As for Mistral, we don't have a computer with a good enough GPU to run that mode

ms.promise:
#1 - Connect the phone app to the Cardano ledger and store proof references data using datum in ADA transactions. A node will track the UTxOs of the created transactions and the specific Data. The metadata attached to the Cardano Transaction we'll be broken down into:
Metadata provided by the phone when taking a picture of the box:
Image format
Quality 
Resolution
Timestamp
Possible Geo-location (We may skip this)
Metadata generated by the shipping company:
Carrier used (USPS, UPS, FedEx, or similar commercial shipping companies)
Cost of the shipment
Date of the shipment
Estimated time of deliver
Metadata of the box:
Box size
Packaging method 
All of this information will be attached to a Cardano transaction as metadata at this stage. 
#2 - Explore SmartPack GUI and user process flow by creating mockups of the completed platform and testing with test groups. The mockups will be of the front end of the future commercial version of the service where we see if the sequence of steps (take photo, input shipping information, and submitting a transaction) are clear to a general user. 
This will be a test group of between 10 and 15 people that will go through the stages of using the app to
ms.criteria:
#1 - Cardano transactions that have metadata appended to them. With all the relevant information mentioned above for each package sent. 
#2 - Different GUI mockups that show we have gone through a design process that maximizes the simplicity of the app. The design process resulted in several possible GUI for the mobile app. 
3# - Organize a test group of six individual that are located inside the USA who will use the system end-to-end.
